plans.note: Section 15 is headed 'Limitation of Garman's Liability' — one-sided by title; check cap amount, mutuality and carve-outs (IP indemnity in sec-13, confidentiality in sec-14, willful misconduct).
IP indemnity exists at sec-13; verify scope (defence, settlement, no cap interaction with sec-15) and confirm no broad reciprocal indemnity from us.
No non-compete heading; if any restriction on our business or competing products appears it would sit in Restrictions on Use (sec-3) or General Matters (sec-20).
Check the licence grant and maintenance/fees clauses for sole-source or exclusive-provider language for routing software or support; otherwise absent.
Fees (sec-11) and maintenance pricing (sec-10) are the only plausible homes for MFN/best-pricing wording; likely no MFN either way.
Section 19 'Non-Solicitation of Employees' applies to us — check mutuality, duration (≤12 months) and a general-advertising/unsolicited-applicant carve-out.
Term and Termination (sec-17) plus the reject-option clauses (sec-7, sec-8); confirm we have notice-based exit without penalty and Garman cannot terminate at will mid-term.
Maintenance term/auto-renewal likely in sec-10 with term mechanics in sec-17; check notice window (≤30-60 days) and any uplift cap in fees (sec-11).
Governing law/venue almost certainly inside General Matters (sec-20), which runs across the page-break sections; verify acceptable jurisdiction and courts rather than arbitration.
Assignment likely in General Matters (sec-20); also check the grant (sec-2) for restrictions on transfer to affiliates/successors and sec-17 for change-of-control termination rights.
Confirm Garman claims only its own software IP; our data (conversion under sec-4) and Confidential Information (sec-14) stay ours, and escrow (sec-16) supports continuity.

Grant of Licence (sec-2) with Restrictions on Use (sec-3) and definitions of Authorized Locations (sec-1); seek affiliate/contractor use and remove revocable-at-will or unilateral suspension language.
No audit heading; any usage-verification right would sit in Restrictions on Use (sec-3) or General Matters (sec-20) — if present, add notice, frequency and vendor-cost limits.
Check fees (sec-11) for late-payment interest or penalties and co-operation/implementation (sec-9) for charges triggered by our delay; no liquidated damages clause apparent.
Specifications and Warranty (sec-12) is the core; cross-check acceptance testing (sec-6), reject option (sec-7) and maintenance (sec-10) for warranty duration and repair/replace/refund remedy.
No insurance provision visible; Garman personnel attend our sites for delivery/installation (sec-4) and training (sec-5), so propose standard coverages in General Matters (sec-20).
Review fees (sec-11) and maintenance (sec-10) with the schedules referenced in sec-1 for minimum seat/location counts or non-cancellable multi-year maintenance commitments.
Termination (sec-17) and survival (sec-18) likely address only return/destruction of software; add exit assistance and return of our converted data (sec-4), leveraging escrow (sec-16).
